name: Binaural Jazz
description: A jazz club built for headphones: the bass, kick and lead horn stay in the centre while the rest of the band uses the space between your ears. A kit set up around you, a ballad widened by tiny delays, a modal vamp whose phase rotates, horn chords split by partials, vibes that hop from ear to ear, a smoky room with glasses clinking behind you, guide tones hidden in noise, a bebop line whose brightness wanders, a bossa that drifts apart in cents and a last-call ballad over a slow delta drone. Every sketch is a complete tune of a minute and a half or more, with an intro, a head, solos or a bridge and a proper ending. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Brushes in the Round
sketches.description: A swinging ii-V-I in F with the kit set up around you: the ride on your right, the hats on your left, brushes circling your head, piano a little to the left and the saxophone straight ahead. An intro, the head with a turnaround, the head again into a solo chorus, a last head and a slowing outro: about a minute and a half.

sketches.name: Wide Ballad
sketches.description: A ballad in E-flat where delays between the ears do the mixing: the piano grows wider each bar as its delay rises from 1 to 25 milliseconds, the brushes sway on delays under a millisecond, and the tenor sax has no delay at all. Piano alone, the tune twice (the second time an octave lower), a coda and a last chord, slowing to a stop: about a minute and forty seconds.

sketches.name: Modal Rotation
sketches.description: A modal vamp in D dorian that lifts to E-flat dorian and back, twice. The quartal pad steps from centred to diffuse through interaural phase and opens up through every section, while a vibraphone drone rolls slowly around inside your head, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. About a minute and a half.

sketches.name: Split Quartet
sketches.description: Spectral fusion on the bandstand: the horn section's chords send alternate partials to each ear, and the kit splits its lows from its cymbals at 900 Hz. Neither ear hears the whole band; together, and in mono, it is complete. Three heads, each opening up a little more, with two guitar solos between them and a tag: under two minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(108/4)

// The head, a guitar solo, the head again, a second solo with new draws, a last head and a tag
song("intro@4 head@8 solo@8 head'@8 solo'@8 head''@8 tag@4", "once")
tempomap("0:27 44:27 48:20")

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials of each chord between the ears: F7, Bb7, F7, C7
// The horns lay out during the solos and open up a little more on every head
horns: note("<[f3,a3,c4,eb4] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [f3,a3,c4,eb4] [c3,e3,g3,bb3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(2000)
  .decay(.6).sustain(.2).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.18)
  .sections("head tag").variant(x => x.lpf(2600), x => x.lpf(3200).room(.6))

// earsplit("bands") puts the kick and snare body in one ear and the ride in the other
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd, rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]")
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.5).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// A plain, centred walking bass, softer in the intro
bass: note("<[f2 a2 c3 eb3] [bb1 d2 f2 ab2] [f2 eb2 d2 c2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(bysec("intro:.4 *:.48"))

// A centred guitar answers between the chords in the head
guitar: n("<[~ ~ 4 5 6 4 ~ ~] [~ ~ 3 4 3 1 0 ~] [~ ~ 6 7 9 7 6 4] [5@4 ~@4]>").scale("F:mixolydian").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.2).swing(4).gain(.2)
  .sections("head")

// In the solos the guitar improvises over the blues; the primed solo draws new notes
solo: n("0 2 [4 5] 6 [7 6] 4 [2 1] 0").add("<0 3 0 4>").scale("F:mixolydian").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("blues")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.15).swing(4).gain(.22)
  .sections("solo")

sketches.name: Ear-to-Ear Vibes
sketches.description: A bebop vibraphone leans right with a level difference between the ears, and a patterned ear swap flips some notes to the left, so the line hops between your ears. A guitar answers on the other side, swapping once a bar. Between the heads the vibes trade improvised choruses with new ear swaps each time, then a tag: about a minute and a half.
sketches.source:
setcpm(144/4)

// The head, a trade, the head, two more trades, the last head and a tag
song("intro@4 head@8 trade@8 head'@8 trade'@8 trade''@8 head''@8 tag@4", "once")
tempomap("0:36 52:36 56:26")

// ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the ears on the steps marked 1
// Through Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7, G7
vibes: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").add("<0 5 1 4>").scale("C:major").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).ild(9).earswap("0 1 0 1 1 0 1 0")
  .decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).swing(4).gain(.2).sections("head tag")

// In the trades the vibes improvise with their own ear swaps; every primed trade draws new notes
vibesolo: n("0 [2 4] 6 [7 9] 8 [6 4] [3 2] 1").add("<0 5 1 4>").scale("C:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("trade")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).ild(9).earswap("0 0 1 1 0 1 1 0")
  .decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.4).swing(4).gain(.2).sections("trade")

// A guitar counter-line that swaps ears once per bar
guitar: n("<[~ 4 ~ 2] [~ 0 ~ 2] [~ 3 ~ 1] [~ 6 ~ 4]>").scale("C:major")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").ild(6).earswap("<0 1>")
  .decay(.4).sustain(.2).release(.3).gain(.18).exceptSections("intro")

// A centred walking bass and kit, with a fill at the end of every section
bass: note("<[c2 e2 g2 b2] [a1 c2 e2 g2] [d2 f2 a2 c3] [g1 b1 d2 f2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.48)
drums: stack(
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.24),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.22),
  s("bd*4").lpf(200).gain(.28)
).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

sketches.name: Smoky Club
sketches.description: Headphones on: a table near the stage. The band plays in front of you, the room tone is wide and diffuse, glasses clink at the bar behind you and footsteps pass in the lobby beyond the wall. The doors open, the band plays a set, steps off while the pianist plays alone, comes back with the trumpet's mute out and the lights go up: over two minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Doors open, the first set, a break with solo piano, a short last set and lights up
song("doors@4 set@16 set'@16 break@8 set''@8 lights@4", "once")

// The room: chatter, unrelated noise in each ear for a wide room tone, and glasses at the bar behind you
// The crowd gets louder whenever the band is off
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(bysec("doors:.18 break:.16 lights:.2 *:.1"))
roomtone: s("pink").slow(8).icorr(.15).lpf(1200).gain(.03)
glasses: s("click*8?0.15").hpf(3000).azimuth(160).distance(4).seed("bar").gain(.12)

// Footsteps in the lobby, beyond the wall
lobby: s("step ~ step ~").azimuth(-120).distance(5).occlude(.6).gain(.1)

// The band on stage: drums at the back, bass on the left, piano on the right, horn in front
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd?0.3, ~ sd?0.2 ~ sd, rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").distance(4).seed("club").room(.3).gain(.4)
  .sections("set").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<[bb1 d2 f2 a2] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [c2 eb2 g2 bb2] [f1 a1 c2 eb2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).azimuth(-30).distance(3).gain(.46)
  .sections("set")

// The pianist stays on through the break
piano: note("<[a3,d4,f4] [b3,d4,f4] [bb3,eb4,g4] [a3,eb4,g4]>").struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ [~@2 x]")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(.1).release(.3).azimuth(35).distance(3).gain(.22)
  .sections("set break")

// A muted trumpet, close in front; from the second set on the mute comes out
trumpet: note("<[d5@3 c5 bb4@2 f4@2] [g4@4 b4@2 d5@2] [eb5@3 d5 c5@2 bb4 g4] [a4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").vowel("u").lpf(2000).vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2).distance(2).room(.3).gain(.2)
  .sections("set").variant(x => x.vowel("a").lpf(2800))

sketches.name: Ghost Changes
sketches.description: The off-beat brushes are white noise, but between the ears they carry the chord tones of a ii-V-I (Huggins pitch). Each ear alone hears only hiss. A quiet vibraphone plays the changes first so you know what to listen for, returns once alongside the ghosts, and then the bass and ride drop out and only the noise carries the harmony. The effect is faint and differs between listeners. About a minute and forty seconds.

sketches.name: Bebop Brightness
sketches.description: Nothing is panned, yet a fast bebop line's brightness bounces between your ears: each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions. The comping pad is thinner on the right, where a high-pass cuts its body. The head, three solo choruses with fresh lines, the head again and a tag: about a minute and a half.

sketches.name: Cents Bossa
sketches.description: Bossa nova for headphones: the nylon-string chords drift apart between the ears in cents, a chord at a time. At 2 cents they beat slowly, at 6 and 12 they shimmer and at 30 they bloom into a chorus. The flute, bass and clave stay centred. The guitar alone, the tune, a bridge where the flute rests and the room opens, the tune an octave lower and a last chord: about a minute and a half.
sketches.source:
setcpm(136/8)

// One cycle is two bars. The guitar alone, the tune, a bridge, the tune again and a final chord
song("intro@2 tune@8 bridge@8 tune'@8 last@1", "once")
tempomap("0:17 25:17 27:11")

// The clave on the rim, a brushed shaker and a soft surdo kick
perc: stack(
  s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").gain(.4),
  s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(saw.range(.1, .24).fast(8)),
  s("bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd").lpf(260).gain(.5)
).exceptSections("intro")

// earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left by half the value each: Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7, G7
// The room opens in the bridge, and the last chord rings a little louder
guitar: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,d4,e4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").earsh("<2 6 12 30>")
  .attack(.003).decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.3).lpf(2400)
  .room(bysec("bridge:.6 *:.35")).gain(bysec("last:.32 *:.28"))

// Upright bass on the dotted quarter
bass: note("<[c2@3 g1]*4 [a1@3 e2]*4 [d2@3 a1]*4 [g1@3 d2]*4>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.55).exceptSections("intro")

// A breathy flute in the middle; it rests in the bridge and comes back an octave lower
flute: note("<[g5@2 e5 d5 b4@3 ~] [c5@2 b4 a4 e5@3 ~] [f5@3 e5 c5@2 a4 c5] [d5@2 b4 g4 f4@3 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12).attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.4)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("tune").variant(x => x.add(-12).vibdepth(.08))

sketches.name: Last Call Delta
sketches.description: The last set, chairs on the tables: a slow ballad in F over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. A sparse piano, soft brushes and a tenor sax far across the empty room, who walks closer for the second chorus. The drone rises and fades over the whole piece and the tempo slows into the last chord: under two minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// An intro on the drone and chords, two choruses, a coda and one last chord, slowing at the end
song("intro@4 ballad@8 ballad'@8 coda@3 last@1", "once")
tempomap("0:14 20:14 24:9")

// A 2 Hz binaural drone: each ear is detuned by 1 Hz, so a slow beat forms between them
// One arc over the whole song: it rises, holds and fades out by the end
// Fmaj7, Dm7, Gm7, C7
drone: note("<f1 d1 g1 c1>").s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(env("0 .24@6 0", "song"))

// Sparse piano, a few notes gently left out
piano: n("<[2 ~ 4 ~] [~ 6 ~ 4] [3 ~ ~ 5] [~ 4 ~ 2]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("last-call")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(2)
  .room(.6).size(.85).gain(.24).sections("ballad")

// The chords play throughout; each section restarts them, so the last bar is Fmaj7
chords: note("<[e3,a3,c4] [c3,f3,a3] [f3,bb3,d4] [e3,bb3,d4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(1).sustain(.5).release(3).lpf(900)
  .room(bysec("intro:.7 coda:.75 last:.85 *:.6")).gain(.16)

// Soft brushes, centred
brushes: s("pink*4").hpf(2500).lpf(6000).decay(.15).sustain(0).swing(4).gain(.04)
  .sections("ballad")

// A tenor sax far across the empty room; on the second chorus it walks closer
sax: note("<[a4@3 g4 f4@4] ~ [d5@2 c5 a4 g4@4] ~>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o").lpf(1600).mono(1).glide(.08)
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.15).attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(1)
  .azimuth(-20).distance(7).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.16)
  .sections("ballad").variant(x => x.azimuth(-10).distance(3))
